mapper.select: SELECT r.*,s.file_name,s.file_sha256 FROM pur_order_import r LEFT JOIN pur_order_import_source s ON s.country_id=r.country_id AND s.id=r.source_id WHERE r.country_id=#{countryId} AND r.batch_id=#{batchId} AND r.group_id=#{groupId} ORDER BY r.row_no
SELECT id,doc_no FROM pur_order WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id} AND book_id=#{bookId}
SELECT id FROM pur_order_line WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT * FROM pur_order_import_group WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_group SET fee_todos=#{feeTodos}::jsonb,fee_todos_version=fee_todos_version+1 WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
